Your complaint will receive a reference number, an acknowledgement within **2 business days**, and a detailed response within **10 business days**. If needed, we can escalate this further to our Head of Customer Experience.

priority_reason: Customer is experiencing a payment problem, which blocks product access if unresolved.
reply: I’m sorry to hear about the trouble with your online payment. Could you clarify the issue—e.g., whether the payment failed, was declined, or appears incorrect? For failed payments, try updating your card in **Settings → Billing → Payment method** or use **Retry payment**. If the problem persists, share the invoice number, and we’ll investigate within 2 business days.

priority_reason: Information request with no action needed urgently (base level L).
reply: You can subscribe to our monthly Nimbus CRM newsletter by visiting [nimbuscrm.example/newsletter](nimbuscrm.example/newsletter) or navigating to **Settings → Notifications → Newsletter** in your account. If you’d like to unsubscribe, you can do so by clicking **Unsubscribe** at the bottom of any newsletter email or by turning it off in the same **Notifications** menu. Changes take effect within 48 hours.

priority_reason: Question about support hours is a courtesy request with no action needed urgently (base level L).
reply: You can check our customer service hours in the help centre at **Settings → Help → Contact us** or directly [here](nimbuscrm.example/contact). Live chat and phone support are available **Monday–Friday, 8:00–20:00 (GMT)**. Email support is answered 24/7.

priority_reason: Asking how to get a refund (base level M).
reply: To request a refund, log in to your account and go to **Settings → Billing → Invoices**. Next to the relevant invoice, click **Request refund**. If you need further assistance, let us know the invoice number, and we’ll help.

priority_reason: Question about payment methods (base L). No frustration or urgency indicated.
reply: Our accepted payment methods are Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and PayPal for all plans. Bank transfer (wire/ACH) is available only for annual plans of $5,000 or more. We do not accept cheques or cryptocurrency. You can update your payment method in **Settings → Billing → Payment method**.

priority_reason: Customer is blocked from using the product (sign-up error).
reply: To report a sign-up error, please reply here with a screenshot of the error message. Our team will investigate and help you resolve it within 2 business days. You can also check if your email is already registered by using the **Forgot password** option.

priority_reason: Asking how to request a refund (base level M).
reply: To request a refund, you can do so directly in your account under **Settings → Billing → Invoices → Request refund** next to the relevant invoice. Alternatively, you can contact support with the invoice number, and we’ll assist you. Please note our refund policy allows full refunds within 14 days for monthly plans or 30 days for annual plans.

priority_reason: Customer needs to update account details, which is not urgent but requires action.
reply: To update your Platinum account details, go to **Settings → Profile** in your Nimbus CRM workspace. Here, you can edit your name, email, or company details. If you’re changing your email address, you’ll need to confirm the update from both your old and new email addresses. Let us know if you need further assistance!

priority_reason: Formal complaint lodging is a churn signal, requiring urgent attention (explicit rule: 'Formal complaints = H').
reply: You can lodge a formal complaint by submitting a form at **nimbuscrm.example/complaints** or emailing **complaints@nimbuscrm.example**. Every complaint receives a reference number, an acknowledgement within **2 business days**, and a written response within **10 business days**. If you need further assistance, a specialist will follow up shortly.
